title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → Course
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models.

source_tables.description: Course catalog base. Subject, course number, title, credit hours, level, college, department. Effective-term dated.
Course description. Long text catalog description (may be in SCBCRSE.SCBCRSE_LONG_TITLE or separate SCBDESC table depending on version).
Course level restrictions. Defines which student levels (UG, GR) can enroll.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + SCBCRSE_SUBJ_CODE + SCBCRSE_CRSE_NUMB.
Direct map. Use current effective-term row (max SCBCRSE_EFF_TERM where EFF_TERM <= current term).
Direct map. Minimum credits for variable-credit courses.
Direct map. For fixed-credit courses, same as min.

attribute_mappings.source: SCBCRSE.SCBCRSE_LEVL_CODE or derived from course number
attribute_mappings.transformation: Map Banner level codes via STVLEVL: 'UG'→derive from number (1000-2999='undergraduate_lower', 3000-4999='undergraduate_upper'), 'GR'→'graduate', 'DR'→'doctoral'.
Resolve department code to HELIX AcademicOrg.helix_id via STVDEPT.
Resolve effective term code to term start date.
